title: Login heading names the wrong screen
detail:
Observed

Đăng Ký

on /login; expected a Login heading such as “Đăng nhập”.

title: Browser tab title is not page-specific
detail: document.title = "frontend-web" on /login; expected “Đăng nhập — EShop” or similar.

title: Login fields have wrong types and no programmatic labels
detail: Both inputs are type="text" (password is visible); labels “Username”/“Mật khẩu” have no for/id association; axe-core reports 2 critical label violations.

title: Tab order starts at the submit button
detail: The Sign In button has tabindex="1", so the first Tab from the page focuses it before the email/password fields. Visual order is violated.

title: Login error is generic and not announced
detail: Only “Đăng nhập thất bại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.” is shown, with no role="alert"/aria-live, no field association and no distinction between wrong credentials, lockout or network failure.

title: Authenticated user still sees the Login form
detail: The header shows “Chào, HW03 UI Tester” but /login still renders the login form instead of redirecting to the home page.

title: Forgot-password link causes a full page reload
detail: The link is a raw <a href="/forgot-password">; window.__spaMarker was lost after the click, proving a full document reload instead of React Router navigation.

title: Helper text and primary button fail WCAG AA contrast
detail: axe-core: helper text #9ca3af on #ffffff = 2.53:1; white on #ef4444 = 3.76:1 (both below 4.5:1).

title: Password rule text contradicts the implementation
detail: The helper text promises “ký tự đặc biệt”, but the regex requires a whitespace character and rejects special characters. “Abcd1234!” is rejected although it satisfies the displayed rule.

title: Registration accepts a malformed email address
detail: The email field is type="text" with no format check. “not-an-email-1794048870220” was accepted and the app redirected to /login.

title: Duplicate email registration is accepted silently
detail: Registering “dup1794048871770@example.com” twice both redirected to /login with no error. The backend has no unique constraint on email.

title: No loading or disabled state while registering
detail: During a delayed /api/register request the button remains enabled, keeps the label “Đăng Ký”, and has no aria-busy/spinner. Double submits are possible.

title: Server errors are rendered verbatim
detail: The catch block renders err.response.data.error directly. A simulated 500 produced “SQLITE_ERROR: no such column: name” in the UI.

title: OTP is displayed in the page instead of being sent privately
detail: Step 2 shows “Mã OTP của bạn là: 1183” in a green success box. Anyone with the email address can read the reset code on screen.

title: Primary and secondary actions look identical
detail: “Đặt lại mật khẩu” and “← Quay lại” are both full-width green buttons with the same styling, so the destructive primary action has no visual priority.

title: OTP input has no numeric/4-digit constraint
detail: The OTP field is type="text" with no maxlength, inputmode="numeric" or pattern; it accepts arbitrary text and length.

title: Focus is lost after the step transition
detail: After “Lấy mã OTP”, document.activeElement is BODY. Focus is not moved to the OTP field or the step-2 heading.

title: No step indicator on the two-step reset flow
detail: Step 2 shows no “2/2” or progress indicator; users cannot tell how many steps remain.

title: Invalid-email feedback uses a blocking native alert
detail: Observed alert: “Lỗi: User not found”. No inline message, no field highlight and no accessible live region.

title: Profile has no h1 and no page-specific title
detail: document.title = "frontend-web"; the page contains two <h2> elements and zero <h1>. Heading hierarchy and browser tab do not identify the Profile screen.

title: Profile inputs are not associated with their labels
detail: All four <label> elements lack for/id; axe-core reports critical label violations. Screen readers announce the inputs without names.

title: Profile text/status contrast fails WCAG AA
detail: axe-core: yellow #fde047 on blue #2563eb = 3.92:1; white on red #ef4444 = 3.76:1. Both are below 4.5:1 for normal text.

title: Valid Vietnamese phone number is rejected by a blocking alert
detail: Observed alert: “Số điện thoại không hợp lệ. Vui lòng nhập đúng 9-10 chữ số.”. The regex /^[1-9][0-9]{8,9}$/ rejects every number starting with 0, including the placeholder 0912345678; feedback is not inline.

title: Profile update feedback is a blocking alert
detail: Observed alert: “Cập nhật thành công!”. There is no inline success message, no aria-live region and no focus/state update after saving.

title: Order history shows the empty state while still loading
detail: During a delayed /api/orders/my-orders request, “Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.” is already visible; there is no spinner, skeleton or aria-busy state.

title: Order-history failure is shown as an empty list
detail: When /api/orders/my-orders returns 500, the catch block sets orders=[] and the UI says “Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.” No error message or retry action is shown.

title: Cancel-order has no confirmation and is offered for shipping orders
detail: The “Hủy đơn” button is shown for a “Đang giao” order and calls the API immediately; the only dialog is the error “Lỗi: Order not found”. No “Bạn có chắc?” confirmation.

title: Unauthenticated /profile does not redirect to Login
detail: The URL stays /profile and only the text “Vui lòng đăng nhập” is rendered. There is no redirect and no return path.

title: Logout leaves the user on the protected Profile URL
detail: After “Thoát”, the URL remains /profile and the page shows “Vui lòng đăng nhập” instead of navigating to a public page.

title: Navigation has no active/current-page indication
detail: The header links have only hover styles; no aria-current, active class or visual state identifies the current Profile page.

title: Order-history table forces horizontal page scrolling on mobile
detail: At 360px viewport the page scrollWidth is 399px (39px overflow) because the 5-column table keeps its desktop width. The table has no responsive card layout or scroll container.

title: RTL direction does not mirror the layout
detail: With dir="rtl", physical Tailwind utilities keep the “Quên mật khẩu?” link right-aligned and the header/order unchanged; the layout is not mirrored for RTL readers.

title: Register page has no page-specific tab title
detail: document.title = "frontend-web" on /register; expected a Register-specific title.

title: Forgot Password page has no page-specific tab title
detail: document.title = "frontend-web" on /forgot-password; expected a Forgot Password-specific title.

title: Forgot Password email field has no email input semantics
detail: The email field is type="text" with no inputmode/pattern; malformed addresses are only rejected by the backend after submission.

title: Register form has no confirm-password field
detail: Only one password input is present; a typo cannot be detected before account creation.

title: Login button has no loading or disabled state
detail: During a delayed /api/login request the button remains enabled, keeps the label “Sign In” and has no spinner/aria-busy. Double submits are possible.

title: Successful registration redirects silently
detail: After a successful POST /api/register the app navigates to /login without any success message, so the user cannot tell whether the account was created.

title: Reset form has no confirm-password field
detail: Step 2 asks for only one “Mật khẩu mới” input; a typo locks the user out of the new password.

title: Phone field has no tel inputmode or format constraint
detail: The phone input is type="text" with no inputmode="tel", pattern, maxlength or minlength; mobile users get a full keyboard and arbitrary input is accepted until submit.
